entities.name: Djanira da Motta e Silva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Djanira da Motta e Silva, known artistically as just Djanira, was a Brazilian painter, illustrator and engraver. She was known for her naïve art paintings, depicting Brazilian common people, religious themes and landscapes.
